mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_std_dict (dict_id, dict_nm, dict_desc, default_yn, use_yn, term_last_word_clsf_yn, upper_yn, word_eng_nm_dup_yn, term_eng_max_len, old_std_yn, homonym_yn, term_eng_abrv_dup_yn, dict_tp, parent_dict_id, cret_dt, cret_user_id, updt_dt, updt_user_id) VALUES (#{dictId}, #{dictNm}, #{dictDesc, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, COALESCE(#{defaultYn, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'N'), 'Y', COALESCE(#{termLastWordClsfYn, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'N'), COALESCE(#{upperYn, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'Y'), COALESCE(#{wordEngNmDupYn, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'Y'), #{termEngMaxLen, jdbcType=INTEGER}, COALESCE(#{oldStdYn, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'N'), COALESCE(#{homonymYn, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'N'), COALESCE(#{termEngAbrvDupYn, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'N'), COALESCE(#{dictTp, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'ORG'), NULLIF(#{parentDictId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, ''), to_char(now(), 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'), #{userId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, to_char(now(), 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'), #{userId, jdbcType=VARCHAR})

dict_tp = COALESCE(#{dictTp, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, dict_tp), parent_dict_id = NULLIF(#{parentDictId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, ''), updt_dt = to_char(now(), 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'), updt_user_id = #{userId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} WHERE dict_id = #{dictId}
